Name: Er, Father of Lecah
Summary: Son of Shelah son of Judah, called the father of Lecah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:21: Son of Shelah son of Judah, called the father of Lecah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Er stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
